description: Defines a class for an AJAX command to open content in an off-canvas dialog in Drupal, extending the OpenDialogCommand class with specific configurations and rendering effects.

classes.name: OpenOffCanvasDialogCommand
classes.description: A class representing an AJAX command to open an off-canvas dialog with specific configurations and effects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the off-canvas dialog command with customizable options, including position, classes, and width.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Overrides the parent render method to add fade effect and set animation speed for the dialog.
